neverSharePin.title: Never Share UPI PIN
neverSharePin.description: No legitimate organization will ever ask for your UPI PIN. Never share it with anyone, even if they claim to be from your bank.

verifyBeforePay.title: Verify Before Paying
verifyBeforePay.description: Always double-check the recipient name and amount before confirming any UPI transaction. Scammers often use similar names.

fakeLinks.title: Recognize Fake Payment Links
fakeLinks.description: Fake payment links look real but lead to scammer accounts. Always verify the URL and never click suspicious links in SMS or emails.

dontRush.title: Don't Rush Decisions
dontRush.description: Scammers create urgency to make you act without thinking. Take your time and verify before taking any action.

checkSender.title: Check Sender Number
checkSender.description: Verify the sender's phone number. Banks and government agencies rarely communicate via unsolicited SMS with links.

report.title: Report Suspicious Activity
report.description: If you receive a suspicious message or call, report it to your bank and the National Cyber Crime Helpline at 1930.
